name: Zero Mass
description:
About This Game

100% ASTEROID. 0% LEFT.

One enormous asteroid. One mining ship. One simple goal: reduce it to absolutely nothing.

ZERO MASS is a satisfying space-mining incremental where you carve through massive procedurally generated asteroids, extract valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and build an increasingly powerful mining operation.

Every asteroid starts at 100% mass. Your job is to bring that number all the way down to 0%.

What begins as a small mining operation gradually becomes an industrial dismantling machine. Mine faster, haul more, automate repetitive work, and watch enormous space rocks disappear piece by piece.

Mine. Upgrade. Automate. Obliterate.

BREAK IT ALL DOWN

Forget simply mining a few valuable rocks and moving on.

In ZERO MASS, the asteroid itself is your project. Cut into its surface, carve away huge sections, expose hidden resources, and watch your progress as its remaining mass steadily decreases.

Every chunk you remove brings you closer to completing the job.

The goal isn't just to find resources. It's to leave nothing behind.

FROM A SINGLE SHIP TO A MINING OPERATION

Start small. Get stronger. Become unstoppable.

  • Mine and dismantle: Tear through asteroids using your mining spaceship.

  • Collect and profit: Haul valuable ore to your space silo and turn extracted resources into upgrades.

  • Improve your equipment: Upgrade your mining tools, ship capabilities, and extraction efficiency.

  • Deploy machinery: Put mining drones and drilling rigs to work.

  • Automate your operation: Reduce repetitive tasks and increase your mining output.

  • Complete contracts: Take on new challenges and expand your industrial capabilities.

Each improvement makes the next asteroid faster and more satisfying to dismantle.

THERE'S MORE INSIDE THE ROCK

Not every asteroid is just a pile of minerals.

Explore procedurally generated asteroid fields, uncover buried artifacts, discover valuable deposits, and prepare for dangerous encounters.

Every new excavation offers another chance to find something unexpected.

The deeper you go, the more your equipment and decisions matter.

PUT YOUR EQUIPMENT TO WORK

Deploy mining and collection drones, assign them to an asteroid, and set their priorities. Unlock surface drilling rigs to excavate alongside you while you manage the wider operation.

DISCOVER WHAT LIES INSIDE

Scan your surroundings and recover artifacts buried beneath the surface. Turn discoveries and survey rewards into research for improved scanners and new equipment.

THE SATISFACTION OF ZERO

There's something deeply satisfying about watching a huge object gradually disappear.

The first few cuts. The growing excavation. The improved mining speed. The drones working around you. The moment an enormous asteroid becomes a handful of fragments.

And finally...

100% → 50% → 10% → 1% → 0%.

Job complete.

Time to find a bigger asteroid.

YOUR ASTEROID. YOUR OPERATION. YOUR PROGRESS.

ZERO MASS combines the satisfying repetition of mining, the progression of incremental games, and the spectacle of large-scale destruction into a focused space-mining experience.

No complicated empire to manage. No endless survival chores.

Just you, your mining equipment, and an entire asteroid waiting to disappear.

How fast can you reach ZERO MASS?
short_desc: Turn massive asteroids into absolutely nothing! Mine, break, and dismantle procedurally generated space rocks from 100% to 0%. Collect valuable resources, upgrade your mining ship, deploy drones, and automate your operation in this satisfying space-mining incremental.
